title: Finds a decision phrased with different words than the question

executive.name: Morgan Blake
executive.bio: Fictional commercial leader for evaluation scenarios.

documents.title: Enterprise pricing decision
documents.content: Decision from the October 2026 commercial review: enterprise accounts that sign multi-year agreements receive list prices cut by 15 percent. Single-year contracts stay at list price.

documents.title: Office move plan
documents.content: The Munich team moves to the new office on the third floor in January 2027. Parking permits are reissued in December.

ask.question: Are we giving discounts to big clients?

judge: States that enterprise accounts on multi-year agreements get list prices cut by 15 percent, citing the source.
Does not claim that single-year contracts are discounted.
